Proficient in Python, Flask, HTML, CSS, SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Neo4j, Git, and data‑science tools such as deep learning, EDA, feature engineering, and Power Query.","lines":[{"i":0,"text":"Developed a full‑stack corporate website with React and Flask, organizing product data to improve navigation and customer engagement; added an AI chatbot to automate product inquiries and boost support efficiency."},{"i":2,"text":"Implemented three‑factor authentication with face, voice, and gesture recognition, using deep learning models to improve verification accuracy and reliability."},{"i":3,"text":"Reduced unauthorized access attempts by ~60% using a three‑layer biometric validation pipeline."},{"i":5,"text":"Analyzed RBI UPI transaction data with SQL and DAX, evaluating payment trends and state‑wise growth to provide KPI‑driven insights on transaction velocity and market expansion."},{"i":6,"text":"Built a five‑page interactive Power BI dashboard that integrated transaction, channel, and customer data to reveal behavioral patterns and performance metrics."},{"i":7,"text":"Technologies used (Nov 2025 – Dec 2025): Python, SQL, PyTorch, Flask, PostgreSQL, Neo4j."},{"i":8,"text":"Engineered a fraud detection system that analyzed 500K+ GST transactions across states to identify shell entities and circular trading, structuring relational data and automating graph construction for scalable risk analysis."},{"i":9,"text":"Built a fraud risk scoring model that achieved 87% accuracy with less than 5% false positives."},{"i":10,"text":"Delivered four interactive dashboards for fraud network visualization and risk‑based case prioritization."}]}
